beats.text: Hours after the FCC chairman threatened ABC over a Jimmy Kimmel joke about Charlie Kirk, the network suspended him indefinitely.

beats.caption: This morning, Jimmy Kimmel off the air.
beats.label: via TODAY

beats.text: The FCC chairman had already floated using that same government leverage against the network.

beats.caption: Appears to be some of the sickest conduct possible.
beats.label: via Associated Press

beats.text: Trump could not have been happier, gloating on Truth Social that the ratings-challenged show was finally cancelled.

beats.caption: Congratulating ABC for, quote, finally having the courage to do what had to be done.
beats.label: via TODAY

beats.text: Days later, at a press conference in the UK, a reporter finally asked him about it directly.

beats.caption: You can call that free speech or not. He was fired for lack of talent.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: Free speech, or a president personally lobbying to cancel a comedian, either way, ratings apparently still mattered.
